MacPopup's text box is adapted from [texthooker-ui](https://github.com/Renji-XD/texthooker-ui), by Renji-xD, licensed
under the MIT License (`LICENSE`):

- `web/src/overlay.js`: the processing of new lines (texthooker-ui's App.svelte) and its WebSocket message format
- `web/src/lib/settings-defaults.js`: the text box's settings, which mirror texthooker-ui's
- `web/src/lib/replacements.js`: replacements, in texthooker-ui's format
- `web/src/lib/texthooker-import.js`: importing a texthooker-ui settings export

The license is from https://github.com/Renji-XD/texthooker-ui at commit de2113b35016b43b8c1834813cca51d78d1b1618.
